offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: This page isn't available offline yet. Pages you've opened before still work, and any chores you tick off are saved on this device and synced when you're back online.

install.title: Install Yakka
install.body: Add Yakka to your home screen for one-tap access, offline use and notifications.
install.iosTitle: Add Yakka to your Home Screen
install.iosSteps: Tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.
install.iosNote: Notifications on iPhone only work from the Home Screen app.
